modules.module_purpose: Master the fundamentals of professional research, question formulation, search strategy design, evidence hierarchies, and ethical AI-assisted research documentation.
learning_objectives: Differentiate professional evidence-based research from superficial conversational web searching.
Formulate precise research questions, problem statements, and scope boundaries for business or academic inquiry.
Design multi-stage search strategies using Boolean operators, keywords, synonyms, and search filters.
Evaluate source credibility, primary versus secondary evidence, and apply discipline-specific evidence hierarchies.
Establish reproducible research documentation, citation ethics, and responsible AI-assistance guidelines.
topics_covered: Research hypotheses as a foundational concept
hands_on_exercises: Question Refinement Lab: Transform 3 vague business problems into structured, scoped research questions with measurable parameters.
Search Strategy Blueprinting: Construct Boolean and keyword search strings across 3 research domains using advanced search operators.
Source Credibility Audit: Evaluate 4 disparate information sources (press release, government statistic, blog post, peer-reviewed paper) using a standardized credibility matrix.

faq.question: What is AI Research & Evidence Verification?
faq.answer: AI Research & Evidence Verification is a comprehensive 5-week, 40-hour practical certification course teaching professionals and students how to conduct disciplined market, business, and academic research using modern AI research tools, verify claims against primary sources, and author trustworthy reports.

faq.question: Is this course suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. The course begins with foundational research question design, search operators, and evidence hierarchies before progressing to specialized AI tools, document grounding, and literature comparison. Anyone with basic computer and document literacy can succeed.

faq.question: What is the duration and fee?
faq.answer: The course runs for 5 Weeks with 40 instructional hours (8 hours per week: 4 hours live technical instruction plus 4 hours supervised studio lab). The tuition fee is exactly ₹5,900 plus applicable 18% GST (totaling ₹6,962), adhering to our transparent Truth in Pricing policy.

faq.question: Which AI research tools will I learn?
faq.answer: You will master Perplexity for web and market intelligence, Gemini Notebook for document-grounded research, Google Scholar and Semantic Scholar for scholarly discovery, and Consensus or Elicit for academic evidence synthesis.

faq.question: Will I learn Perplexity?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 02 provides dedicated training in Perplexity workflows, multi-stage query formulation, citation inspection, claim tracing, and separating marketing claims from verified business data.

faq.question: Does the course include Gemini Notebook?
faq.answer: The approved transparent course fee for AI Research & Evidence Verification is ₹5,900 (statutory 18% GST extra). Nova Skills maintains absolute pricing integrity with zero hidden administrative fees. Flexible installment options are available.

faq.question: Will I learn Google Scholar and Semantic Scholar?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 03 teaches you how to search scholarly publications, track citation networks, filter by date and author, navigate DOIs, and access open-access full-text research papers.

faq.question: Does the course teach Consensus or Elicit?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 03 covers question-based academic paper discovery, study screening, sample size evaluation, and structured information extraction using Consensus or Elicit.

faq.question: Do I need paid research software?
faq.answer: No. All core learning outcomes and mandatory portfolio projects are fully achievable using free accounts, accessible educational platforms, instructor demonstrations, and sample datasets. No paid subscriptions are required.

faq.question: What is source verification?
faq.answer: Source verification is the systematic process of confirming that an AI-cited document actually exists, opening the original text, locating the exact supporting passage, checking its context, and evaluating the author's credibility.

faq.question: Can AI-generated citations be incorrect?
faq.answer: Yes. AI answer engines can hallucinate non-existent papers, misattribute claims, misquote numbers, or cite legitimate papers that do not actually support the assertion. That is why independent human verification is a mandatory skill taught in this course.

faq.question: Will I learn academic literature research?
faq.answer: The approved transparent course fee for AI Research & Evidence Verification is ₹5,900 (statutory 18% GST extra). Nova Skills maintains absolute pricing integrity with zero hidden administrative fees. Flexible installment options are available.

faq.question: Does the course cover market and competitor intelligence?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 02 focuses extensively on industry trend research, competitor benchmarking, business model analysis, customer research, and auditing product claims.

faq.question: Will I learn how to compare research studies?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn to construct structured study comparison matrices that contrast sample sizes, methodologies, geographic contexts, and identify contradictory or inconclusive findings.

faq.question: What is an evidence matrix?
faq.answer: An evidence matrix is a structured table (built in Google Sheets) that maps every factual claim to its source title, URL, publication date, exact supporting passage, verification status, and quality rating.

faq.question: How many portfolio projects will I complete?
faq.answer: You will complete exactly two primary assessed research reports: (1) an Evidence-Verified Market & Competitive Intelligence Report, and (2) an Evidence-Based Academic or Industry Literature Review.

faq.question: Will I learn to write professional research reports?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 05 teaches professional report architecture, executive summaries, methodology documentation, data visualization, and transparent statements of limitations and uncertainty.

faq.question: Does this qualify me to conduct formal systematic reviews?
faq.answer: No. The course teaches foundational literature screening and comparative synthesis. It does not qualify you to conduct formal publication-grade PRISMA systematic reviews or statistical meta-analyses.

faq.question: Does the course include advanced statistics?
faq.answer: No. Advanced statistical programming (R/Python), econometric regressions, and complex biostatistical modeling are excluded. The focus is on qualitative synthesis, evidence evaluation, and reporting.

faq.question: Is this an official certification from a research platform?
faq.answer: No. This is an independent professional skill certification issued by Nova Skills based on practical portfolio evaluation. Nova Skills is an independent educational institution.

faq.answer: Graduates apply these skills in roles such as Junior Market Research Assistant, Competitive Intelligence Research Assistant, Business Research Executive, Academic Research Support Coordinator, and Freelance Research Specialist.
